problems.statement_en: Given nine points in space, no four of which are coplanar, fi nd the minimal natural number n such that for any coloring with red or blue of n edges drawn between these nine points there always exists a triangle hav ing all edges of the same color. (China) Second Day – July 16

problems.statement_en: Let V be a finite subset of Euclidean space consisting of points (x,y,z) with in- teger coordinates. Let S1,S2,S3 be the projections of V onto the yz,xz,xy planes, respectively. Prove that |V |2 ≤ |S1||S2||S3| (|X| denotes the number of elements of X). (Italy)
